meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Remove AI-generated code smells (slop) from branch changes or an explicit file list. Locks behavior with regression tests FIRST, then runs categorized cleanup via parallel `deep` agents in batches of 5, then verifies with quality gates. Covers 10 slop categories including performance equivalences, excessive complexity (object annotations, if/elif variant chains), and oversized modules (250+ pure LOC with mandatory modular refactoring). MUST USE when the user asks to "remove slop", "clean AI code", "deslop", "clean up AI-generated code", "remove AI slop", or wants to clean up AI-generated patterns from recent changes. Triggers - "remove ai slops", "clean ai code", "deslop", "cleanup AI generated", "remove AI slop", "clean up AI-generated code", "strip slop", "ai-slop cleanup".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测并清理AI生成的代码坏味道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理AI助手生成的冗余或低效代码
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect and clean AI-generated code smells
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up redundant or inefficient code from AI assistants

howto.what: 此技能清理 AI 生成代码的坏味道。先加回归测试锁定行为，再每批 5 个并行派出 AI 代理按类清理，最后用质量门禁验证。覆盖 10 类，如多余注释、过度防御代码、死代码、重复，及 250 行以上大文件强制拆分。
howto.when: 当用户说 'remove ai slops'、'clean ai code'、'deslop' 等，或表示要清理 AI 生成的代码模式时，会用此技能处理。默认范围是分支改动，也可指定文件列表。

say.text: 请清理这个分支改动里的 AI 坏味道。
say.note: 默认对 main 分支差异执行清理。

say.text: deslop src/foo.py，把里面的 slop 清掉。
say.note: 指定文件范围，只清理它。

say.text: clean up 一下这段 AI 生成的代码。

howto.what_en: Cleans AI-generated code smells. Locks behavior with regression tests, then parallel deep agents (5/batch) clean by category, then quality gates. Covers 10 categories: comments, dead code, duplication, performance, >250-LOC module refactor.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'remove ai slops', 'clean ai code', 'deslop', etc., or asks to clean AI-generated code patterns. Default scope is the branch diff; an explicit file list also works.

say_en.text: Please clean the AI slop in this branch's changes.
say_en.note: Runs on the diff vs main.

say_en.text: Deslop src/foo.py, remove the slop in it.
Clean up this AI-generated code please.
